title: Fix SQL injection — parameterize queries in SqliteMemorySmithDatabase and CodeSearchService
description:
## Source
SonarQube static analysis audit (`Data/Pages/audits/ms-sonar-static-analysis-7-26-26.md`)

## Findings
- **2 instances** in `MemorySmith.Storage/SqliteMemorySmithDatabase.cs` (L151, L811) — string formatting used to build SQL queries
- **3 instances** in `MemorySmith.App/Services/CodeSearchService.cs` (L1673, L2410, L2903) — string formatting used in code-search indexing SQL

## Impact
SQL injection vulnerability — if any input is user-controllable, these queries can be exploited to read/modify database contents.

## Action Required
Replace string interpolation/concatenation in SQL commands with `SqlParameter` or Dapper parameterized queries in both files.

## Effort
~1h40min

## Priority
P0 — Security
